citation.title: Diffusing the Optimal Topology: A Generative Optimization Approach

claim.primary_outcome_paraphrase: On the out-of-distribution task, diffusion followed by five SIMP iterations had lower mean compliance and compliance error than five SIMP iterations alone.
claim.claimed_speedup_basis: No classical runtime is reported; Table 9 compares design quality after equal SIMP iteration counts.
claim.alternatives: Table 9 also compares ten-iteration results. Introduction contribution reports faster inference relative to other generative models, not a classical optimization run.

baseline.classical_iterations: 5 and 10 SIMP iterations (Section 5.7, Table 9); convergence rule not stated
baseline.ml_time: TopoDiff-FF + SIMP inference 2.55 s, including 2.23 s sampling and 0.32 s processing, for each task (Tables 5-7); no pure classical timing
baseline.training_time: 200k training steps; wall time not stated (Section 5, Setup)
baseline.data_generation_cost: 30,000 SIMP-optimized training topologies; generation time not stated (Section 5, Setup/Dataset)
baseline.quality_metric: FE-based compliance, compliance error relative to SIMP, volume fraction error and floating material (Section 5, Evaluation; Tables 5-7)
baseline.quality_gap: Task 2, five SIMP iterations: mean compliance 8.67 hybrid vs 9.87 SIMP; compliance error 20.34% vs 35.13% (Table 9).

R1.evidence: Section 5.7, Table 9: primary classical comparison is design quality after equal iteration counts; no classical speed comparison.

R2.evidence: Section 5.7, Table 9: classical SIMP is compared on quality, without classical runtime or per-iteration time.

R3.evidence: Section 5.7, Table 9: primary classical outcome concerns quality, so speed-claim amortization does not apply.

R4.evidence: Section 5, Evaluation; Tables 5-7 and Section 5.8: compliance of returned designs, volume-fraction error and floating material are evaluated; Task 3 retains high-compliance outliers and Section 5.8 evaluates manufacturable fraction.

reporting.n_test_cases: not stated; results averaged over five runs (Tables 5-7)

notes: Tables 5-6 exclude samples with compliance greater than 100; Table 7 includes them. Inference times in Tables 5-7 compare generative models, not full classical SIMP. No public code or dataset link appears in the paper.
